dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body section towards the posterior extremity.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel mottling distributed across the mid and posterior dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between varying intensities of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Single, distinct, high-contrast dark circular mark located on the anterior dorsal midline.
